gateSignerNote: Public key of the gate server's persistent keypair (server/.gate-keypair.json). initialize_global MUST use this as gate_signer. The private key never leaves the server.
transferFeeNote: v4.2.13 reverts v4.2.12: TransferFee back to 100bps (1% total tax). The transfer hook cannot burn from the source account (token program passes it readonly), so the 20% burn goes back to the crank (every 5 minutes).

raydium.poolRentBufferNote: Lamports held back alongside the Raydium pool-creation fee (mirrors RAYDIUM_POOL_RENT_BUFFER in programs/agentpad/src/constants.rs). Used by the v4.2.7 minimum-raise check.
raydium.graduatorReserveNote: v4.2.11: fixed reserve (0.02 SOL) sent from the 60% LP share to the graduator at pool creation (mirrors GRADUATOR_RESERVE_LAMPORTS). Covers the metadata rent (~0.0137 SOL) plus tx fees, with ~0.006 SOL surplus per graduation accumulating to cover the 6-hour crank fees. The LP side of the pool is reduced by the same amount; the minimum-raise check counts it alongside the pool fee and rent buffer.
raydium.minHarvestSolNote: v4.2.11: crank minimum-value threshold (0.001 SOL of expected SOL out from the 80% swap, mirrors MIN_HARVEST_SOL_LAMPORTS in scripts/harvest_distribute.mjs). Below this the harvest loses money on gas (~0.000025 SOL per run), so the tax is left to accumulate for the next 6-hour run.
